messages:
maria: FYI Vendor-X will change RPC error code semantics next week (503 -> 520). We need partner compatibility coverage.
aj: Got it. Can we measure who calls that exact endpoint? rough counts?
devin: Direct partners: 4. Marketplace adapters: 5 integrations reference it. SI customers often hardcode 503 retry behavior.
sasha: Suggestion: gateway-level mapping shim that translates 520 back to 503 for flagged partners. Add an opt-in flag per partner_id and a debug header so we can trace usage.
maria: Can routing config support a partner-scoped boolean?
aj: Yes. I'll add "legacy_error_mapping": true/false to routing rules and emit metric tag "compat:vx_map" when active.
devin: We'll also need an SDK note for SIs that explains the new code and offers the tiny client-side shim. Keep examples short.
sasha: Example snippet to include in comms: if (err && err.code === 520) err.code = 503 // preserve existing retry behavior

Keep language-agnostic and link to SDK patches.
maria: Plan: enable mapping behind flag now, notify partners with 60-day deprecation window, run canary (5% 24h -> 25% 72h -> 100%).
aj: I'll create alerts for retry spikes, latency increases, and mapped-response rates. Also add rollback steps to runbook.
devin: Marketplace changes: add "compatibility_shield": true to integration manifest and put a banner on the listing about the firmware change. Also prepare SI-runbook for in-field problems.
partner-bot: Partner notification draft scheduled for 2025-05-20T09:00:00Z (status: draft).
maria: Action items: aj -> routing flag + runbook + alerts; sasha -> shim + PR + instrumentation; devin -> partner comms + listing update + SI playbook; maria -> coordinate vendor window and legal copy.
aj: Will post PR and runbook links here when ready.
sasha: Implementing shim behind flag; adding header "x-compat-shim" and a short-lived metric so we can turn off quickly.
maria: Thanks team. Target to have flag + shim live before vendor ship date. Posting updates in #partnerships-ops if blockers crop up. :thumbsup:
